subject: Monthly operational metrics & OKR actions — June snapshot
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Gretchen Park <gretchen@acmecloud.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Monthly operational metrics & OKR actions — June snapshot

Team,

Attached is the June snapshot of the ops dashboard (short version attached). High-level callouts before we dig in at Fri's leadership sync: 

- Latency: P95 has increased from 160ms -> 210ms for hosted Text-Gen routes over the last two weeks. The bump appears correlated with a new client prefix on route /v1/generate that sends long-context requests.
- Cost: Unit token cost up ~13% month-over-month driven by increased long-context generation and fewer cache hits for embeddings.
- Uptime: Infra SLOs still at 99.95%, but we saw a 45-minute partial outage in eu-west-1 on 6/7 (incident-timeline.csv attached).
- Usage: Customer-contributed traffic is +24% for the top 20 accounts; Acme Cloud accounts for ~7% of that growth.

Actions I want captured for the OKR check-in (please add owners and due dates inline):
1) Short-term: roll back the aggressive batching change for the Text-Gen route for the high-context client (marcus). Target: 72h.
2) Cost mitigation: evaluate NPU-quantized model variants for embedding-heavy prefixes and pilot with 1 account (laura). Target: 2 weeks.
3) Reliability: post-mortem of eu-west-1 partial outage and a recommendation on cross-region failover (evelyn). Target: EOW.

Gretchen — FYI on how Acme traffic patterns are affecting our tail latency; we are aligning a plan and will share concrete mitigations.

Please reply with confirmations or adjustments. I will consolidate and circulate the OKR update doc by Tue.

Thanks,

— Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Platform Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachment: June-Metrics-Dashboard.pdf (pdf, 480KB)
Attachment: incident-timeline.csv (csv, 12KB)

Thanks, Steph — quick confirmations inline: 

1) I'll own the embeddings quantization pilot. I'll scope 2 model variants (int8 + 4-bit hybrid), and run throughput/cost sims against the June workload sample. Initial results by Jun 24, production pilot with one account by Jul 8.

2) For reporting, can we add a token-distribution histogram by prefix (4 buckets) to the dashboard? That will make it easier to show whether the latency regression is prefix-localized vs global. I can add this chart to the shared dashboard (needs access to the prefix-labeling table).

3) On Acme: happy to meet their engineering lead if they want to discuss request shaping on their side. Gretchen — do you have a contact who can share sample request distributions (PII-free)?

Laura

Laura Bennett
Senior Product Manager, API Platform
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Monthly operational metrics & OKR actions — June snapshot

Thanks — I confirm the short-term roll back. Notes:

- Action: revert batching parameter "max_batch_latency_ms" for route /v1/generate-highcontext to previous value (from 30ms -> 10ms). This should reduce P95 for the affected route.
- Impact: expected latency improvement of 15–25% on tail; throughput will drop ~6% for that pool.
- Rollback window: immediate; validate against canary traffic and monitor cost delta.

I'll execute the rollback today at 15:00 PT and post results to the dashboard. Marcus

Marcus Lin
Head of Inference Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachment: runbook-rollback-snippet.txt (text, 2KB)

From: Gretchen Park <gretchen@acmecloud.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 08:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Monthly operational metrics & OKR actions — June snapshot

Stephanie/Laura — thanks for the heads up. Our engineering lead (Tom K.) can share aggregated request-size and context-length distributions; we'll scrub any identifiers. Tom will send a CSV by EOD tomorrow.

A couple of asks from our side:
- Can Redwood provide a recommended client-side timeout and chunking pattern for long-context requests? We've seen retries stack during bursts.
- If you pursue quantized embeddings, we'd appreciate a perf/cost comparison for our standard 2048-dim vectors.

Happy to jump on a short call if helpful.

Gretchen
Director of Platform Partnerships
Acme Cloud
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Gretchen Park <gretchen@acmecloud.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Monthly operational metrics & OKR actions — June snapshot

Team — quick consolidated update and next steps (finalized for the leadership OKR doc):

- Marcus: rollback complete. Early canary shows P95 down 18% for the affected prefix (monitoring dashboard updated). Please keep the runbook entry and the rollback snippet in the incident board.
- Laura: please add the token-distribution histogram to the shared dashboard and run the quantization sims against the sample that Acme will provide; aim for a 10% unit-cost improvement without >3% quality regression.
- Evelyn: draft of the eu-west-1 post-mortem due EOD Wed; include failover recommendation and RTO/RPO options.
- Gretchen: appreciate Tom's CSV — once we have that, we'll run a short client-side guidance doc (timeouts/chunking) and share a recommended template you can distribute to your SDK teams.

I'll incorporate these items into the OKR update and circulate tomorrow morning for leadership review. If anyone needs to escalate a timeline, flag it here.

— Stephanie
Director, Platform Ops
Redwood Inference
